notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
description:
Activate Unctus by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become a blue artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
Jan Jansen and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Jan Jansen trigger, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability from step 2, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
